posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
It's a question of us knowing what you have and what you're looking for--and also what engines you own. XP has some tiling backgrounds (though called them "panoramas" instead of "parallax") and those might work, but A, you'd need to own RMXP, and B, you may already have the starry sky, blue sky, etc. that it comes with VXA.
So what
specific
types of tiling backgrounds are you looking for, and in what style? Photo-realistic skies? Wood grain? Simplified ocean waves? That sort of information would be a huge help in pointing you in the right direction!
